_readme: Licence allow-list checked by scripts/check-licences.py (CI job "Licence Check").
packages: every NuGet package ID in any packages.lock.json (direct and transitive) -> SPDX licence expression.
Licences were read from each package nuspec in the local NuGet cache (<license type="expression">); packages without one are listed in notes with how the licence was determined.
allowedLicences: the only SPDX identifiers that pass. An "A OR B" expression passes if either side is allowed; "A AND B" needs both.

exceptions: an explicit, reasoned waiver for a package whose licence is NOT allowed. Each is printed as a WARNING on every run. Reserved for packages that do not ship (build-only, analyzers, test-only); anything else needs a Product Owner decision recorded in its reason.
Entries are keyed by package ID only (not version). When a version bump could change a licence, re-read its nuspec and update the entry.
To add a package: add its ID and licence here in the same commit that adds the PackageReference.

exceptions.reason: Transitive of Svg.Skia, referenced by Tempest.Desktop, so it SHIPS (it is not build-only). MS-PL is outside the allowed set (white-team finding W-B-01). Recorded here, visibly, so the check can run; this is NOT an approved waiver. Product Owner decision needed: replace the SVG renderer, obtain approval to ship MS-PL, or remove this entry.

notes.Avalonia.Angle.Windows.Natives: nuspec <license type="file">LICENSE; the packaged file is the ANGLE Project BSD 3-clause text
notes.SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.Linux.NoDependenc: nuspec has only a licenseUrl (fwlink); the packaged LICENSE.txt is the MIT text (Xamarin / Microsoft)
notes.xunit.abstractions: nuspec has only a licenseUrl (xunit/xunit license.txt); xunit 2.x is Apache-2.0. Test-only, never shipped
